description: Upload one or more files as stable PR/issue attachments (in parallel) and maintain a managed GitHub comment. Returns `uploads` and `failures` (one bad file does not abort the batch). Each success has `url`, `embedUrl`, and `markdown` (prefer embedUrl for GitHub). With no pr/issue, targets the current branch PR, and files already staged for that branch are promoted into it (`promotion`/`promoteError`; renamed branches are followed automatically, or name the old branch with fromBranch). Attachments are public and keys are predictable; upload only non-sensitive media. On an issue, a Markdown artifact (and a gallery link, when there is a gallery) stays in sync with the comment unless `issueArtifacts` is false, the repo sets `comment.issueArtifacts: false`, or the workspace turns it off. Images stay on uploads.sh URLs. Pull requests are unchanged. An artifact failure is a warning and does not fail the attach.

app.description: Which surface is shown: web, ios, android, cli. Worth setting only when the same route exists on more than one surface.

caption.description: What the shot shows, in plain words (up to 140 printable ASCII characters), e.g. "Empty state after deleting the last project". Shown under the image in the PR comment.

contentType.description: Override the Content-Type (applied to every file; ignored when optimize rewrites).

files.description: Paths of the files to upload (at least one).

frame.description: Optional frame before optimize: phone | browser | iphone-16-pro.

fromBranch.description: Promote files staged under this branch name instead of the current branch (for a branch renamed before the PR opened).

issue.description: Attach to this issue. Mutually exclusive with pr.

issueArtifacts.description: Per-call override for issue artifacts. Omit it to follow the repo file, then the workspace setting, then on. `false` skips them. No effect on pull requests. A failure is a warning on `comment.issueArtifact` and does not fail the attach.

keepExif.description: Keep EXIF/XMP/ICC when optimizing (default: strip for privacy on public embeds).

metadata.description: Queryable tags for later search (key→value). Use `path` for the route (e.g. /settings), not route/page. Omit to leave existing tags; pass an object (even {}) to replace them. `state`, `app`, `screen` and `caption` have their own fields.

noComment.description: Upload only; don't create/update the managed comment.

noOptimize.description: Skip client-side image optimization (default: optimize still images to WebP).

noPromote.description: Skip promoting files staged for the current branch into the PR.

optimizeMaxEdge.description: Max long edge in pixels when optimizing (default: 2400).

pr.description: Attach to this pull request. Mutually exclusive with issue.

screen.description: The app screen shown, for views with no route (a mobile or desktop screen), e.g. "Chat". Shown under the image in the PR comment. Use `path` in metadata for web routes.

state.description: The UI state this image shows. Set it whenever the image is one side of a comparison — before/after is the most useful pair in a PR, and is what makes `find_files` with state=after work later.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: attach
title: Attach to GitHub
